reviews.text: Pool Boss is awesome. They’ve serviced our pool for years. All the technicians have been great for both regular service and repairs. George most recently came by and our pool looks absolutely spotless! Connor has also done a fantastic job. Their communication is also great!

PoolBoss built our new pool and the experience was great. We have used other pool companies to remodel our previous pools and the experiences were horrible. Jason, Andrew and team were very professional, patient and knowledgeable throughout the process. Subcontractors were the best I’ve seen. Our site and street were cleaned every day and job was done quickly with no issues. Minor fixes were quick and painless. Highly recommend.

Pool Boss has been amazing to work with. The owners Kristen and Nick are passionate, responsive, and truly committed to bringing your vision to life. They’ve been relentless in completing our project and always easy to reach. It’s clear they care deeply about delivering exactly what their clients want. Highly recommend!

Working with Pool Boss has been an incredible experience from day one. Nick and his team consistently deliver top-tier service that we’ve come to trust and rely on—no matter the season or conditions. Their professionalism, responsiveness, and commitment to excellence set them apart. Whether you're building, upgrading, or maintaining your pool, we wholeheartedly recommend Pool Boss. We’re already looking forward to partnering with them to build our pool in our next home!

We’ve been using pool boss now for almost 7 months and they continuously do such a great job and are always receptive when we have reached out with concerns. We are thankful to have them and the work they do to keep our pool in great shape!

There are already 2 over years since we chose PoolBoss to build our new pool and to provide the maintenance service afterwards and we want to share to potential customers that our experience has been very positive with the company. The build quality toped our expectation and the service provided after has been excellent. We appreciate the weekly maintenance report communication by email detailing the work done with attached picture.

Yall, for ALL your pool needs —RUN DON’T WALK, Pool Boss is the way to go. This local small business owners are so involved in every process. I know several people who have these pools and cannot say enough positive things! Kristen and Nick go above and beyond for their customers, as well as responding in a timely manner. 10/10 recommend!!

I texted and emailed Pool Boss right after a storm hit our house last week.  I asked if they could clean our pool that had bags of dirt, and a huge umbrella that was blown into our pool. I’m so happy to say they showed up first thing the next morning. The pool was pristine clean by noon. I’m so thankful for this company. If you’re looking for new pool service, this is the one! #poolboss ❤️
The POOL Boss crew works as a team...They are proactive with all of their treatments, educating me along the way.   First class experience !

We absolutely love the service we’ve received from Pool Boss. We know that we can always count on Nick and team to provide unmatched, high level service!  It doesn’t matter the time of year and weather, Pool Boss is reliable, professional and dependable!     We highly recommend Pool Boss to anyone looking to build, service or remodel their pool. Can’t wait to have them design the next phase of our yard.

They completed our pool in May and we couldn’t have been happier. Andrew was always responsive and constantly kept me in the loop! Pool Boss exceeded all my expectations! We also use their pool services and know our pool is in the best hands! 10/10 recommend! Whether it’s construction or maintenance, Pool Boss is the right choice!
Service has been great. Attention to any raised.  Poolboss was selected because of their inspection side of the business  They new what was needed to be reviewed and took care of it

I am not one to write reviews, but Pool Boss has been servicing my pool since we moved in 4 years ago.  Nick and the team have always been tremendously responsive to my many questions; professional in every way; competitive pricing; and goes above and beyond for their clients    They even provide weather reports and instructions on how we should react to the extremes.

I highly recommend them.

Best pool company we’ve had!  In the past 10 years we’ve tried 5 different companies, Pool Boss has done the best at keeping the pool balanced.  Not once have we had mustard Alger during the summer with them!

I have been using Pool Boss for weekly cleaning for about 2 years now and I have to say the service has been awesome.  Nick has always been responsive and helpful.  During the days of freezing temperatures, he provided daily emails with helpful information to keep our pool and equipment safe from freezing.  Any time I have reached out to him, I have gotten a response very quickly.  I have compared their price with other pool service companies and when they have looked at my pool they even say it

Storm came through and our pump stopped working. Contacted pool boss to service and figure out the issue. They came out asap and diagnosed and contacted Jandy warranty to come out. Jandy came out and fixed the issue and everything is working great now. Great experience using Pool Boss! Would recommend them 100x over!
New pool and we have been very impressed with the service of Pool Boss from build to maintenance, it has been great.
Have had pool services companies for over 25 years and these guys hands down are the best.  Do not overcharge and know their craft.  Has been a great experience for me

It is a rarity that I feel good enough to go out on a limb and recommend a business, but we have been exceptionally satisfied with Pool Boss.  Most of the pool people I have dealt with are disorganized and unprofessional and can't do much for equipment, etc.  It's like they've never seen a pool controller.   Scheduling repairs is always a hassle.  Pool Boss? Zero problems.  "My widget is broken", their answer is "we'll have it fixed this week".  My pool has never looked better from their regular
Great people doing great work. Highly recommend them for all your pool service and construction needs
